# Semantic Versioning (SemVer) quick reference

If the project uses SemVer (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`):

- **MAJOR**: incompatible API changes
- **MINOR**: backwards-compatible new functionality
- **PATCH**: backwards-compatible bug fixes

If the project does NOT define a public API (or doesn't claim SemVer), avoid forcing SemVer decisions—follow existing repo conventions.
